Subject: Renewal kickoff: resource playbook, stakeholder map & QBR calendar

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As we discussed, I wanted to kick off the renewal / expansion planning so you have our proposed timeline, staffing recommendations, and an initial QBR agenda to review. Attached is a short renewal resource playbook that lays out:

- Timeline for term review and procurement milestones
- Suggested stakeholder roles (technical lead, procurement, legal, exec sponsor)
- Options for a one-time throughput uplift vs. stepped commit increases
- Typical QBR agenda and required prep items

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm the primary stakeholders on your side (technical, procurement, legal, exec).
2) Pick 2–3 preferred windows for a 60-minute QBR in the next two weeks using the poll link below.
3) I'll loop in our CS lead (Kimberly) and your AM (Ben) to draft a mutual action plan once we lock a date.

QBR poll: https://calendar.google.com/poll/novacorp-qbr-2025
Attachments: Novacorp_Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf, QBR_Agenda_DRAFT.docx

If it's helpful, we can include a short capacity readout during the QBR to make the uplift/quant tradeoffs explicit. Looking forward to your availability.

Best,
David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: resource playbook, stakeholder map & QBR calendar

Quick internal note before the prep sync —

We have a couple of ops constraints to flag:
1) For a 100% burst scenario we recommend a 2–3 week lead time to provision dedicated burst nodes if Novacorp wants guaranteed latency SLAs. Shorter bursts can be handled via elastic capacity but with higher token costs.
2) If Novacorp is open to a stepped commit (50% increase for 3 months -> evaluate -> additional step), we can offer a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration tuning costs.
3) I'll draft the ops slide with the provisioning timeline and a short risk checklist (KV cache warm-up, model quantization impact, and monitoring hooks).

Ben — please prepare a mutual action plan template with milestones and acceptance criteria (delivery, latency targets, billing terms). Marissa — flag any recent legal redline templates we should reuse for Novacorp.

Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Reliability Manager | Redwood Inference
